en: Yessss! Now THAT'S a happy ending!
I feel like I'm tearing up... How was it{SAUT}for you, Hikari-chan?
Mm... That was nice. I think it really was{SAUT}a wonderful ending.
Right, right? A story's gotta end happy,{SAUT}like that!

If you expose who you really are,{SAUT}you might get hurt...{PAGE}So, if you hide yourself and just copy{SAUT}the others around you, you won't get{SAUT}hurt, and life will be easier.{PAGE}But, eventually your true self will{SAUT}fade away... and you'll lose sight of{SAUT}what even keeps you alive.

I can understand that, too.{PAGE}I always lacked any confidence in{SAUT}myself and worried about how{SAUT}people saw me...{PAGE}But after meeting my current{SAUT}companions, being accepted{SAUT}by them...{PAGE}And even being needed by them,{SAUT}I eventually came to like who I am.
I see... Do you think... I could ever{SAUT}make companions like that too?
Geez! Why don'tcha just tell us what{SAUT}you really think of us, then!?
Huh?
I'm sure every one of us already{SAUT}considers you a companion.
But I can't fight or help like everyone{SAUT}else... And, we only just met, so...
None of that matters.{PAGE}We're all friends headed for the same{SAUT}goal together, supporting each other...{SAUT}Isn't that enough of a reason?
Friends...{PAGE}I see, thanks...{PAGE}I want to be able to hold my head up{SAUT}high too. I need to get stronger...
Oh, here he comes... Is it time for{SAUT}the key!?
Ngh... Nnnngh!
Wh-Whaaat!? It came out of his eyes!?
Oh, right―it's your first time seeing{SAUT}this, too.
Someone mentioned it to me earlier,{SAUT}but that was a lot more disturbing than{SAUT}what I'd imagined...{PAGE}It's okay to pick up that key... right?
Mmhm, no problems with that so far.{SAUT}It should go to the third lock.
Oh, then we should keep it safe for{SAUT}when everyone returns!
Could you grab it, Fuuka-chan?{SAUT}I'm going to contact Senpai and{SAUT}the others!
Yes, of course!
Hikari...
You cannot... remain part of{SAUT}the audience forever...
Nnh―Ahhh!
Huh!?
Ah!
